subject: general
question: Six persons Aman, Danish, Soniya, Sujit, Ranjan and Yashika are sitting around a circular table facing away from centre. Danish sits fourth to the right of Of Soniya. Yahsika sits to the immediate right of Soniya. Two persons sit between Aman and Ranjan. If Ranjan is an immediate neighbour of Yashika, who sits to the immediate left of Aman?
solution:
**Six persons: ** Aman, Danish, Soniya, Sujit, Ranjan and Yashika (facing away from centre) 

1. Danish sits fourth to the right of Of Soniya. 

2. Yahsika sits to the immediate right of Soniya. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea89d340fb903b88cf525d6a33cdff28fbe75a26bb4b0687fa7126865da9f746.png] 

3. Two persons sit between Aman and Ranjan. 

Case 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffb0ee7f4655d02a2df8b2fcae381752e3caae0dae9b7bce095146315eae1acf.png] 

Case2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/434357ae52d2209fbf3a7ead0eef7813891908a4edc2478da59375aa39fbd831.png] 

The above two cases will be the final arrangement. 

Now, If Ranjan is an immediate neighbour of Yashika we will considder case 2. and in that case Danish sits to the immediate left of Aman.

Hence, if Ranjan is an immediate neighbour of Yashika Danish sits to the immediate left of Aman.
